name: – § 9 – Am 7
requested_by: The Left, ESN, PfE, S&D, ECR
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text: 9.Underlines that the continuing and increasing supply of arms and ammunition risks exacerbating the destruction, death and suffering that has already occurred, and deeply regrets the fact that the volume of bilateral military aid to Ukraine from Member States continues to increase;
